notes.not_covered: Four further TN G.O.s were downloaded and OCR'd on 22 Nov 2026 but are NOT ingested here (their schedules were not visually verified page by page): Construction (G.O.(2D) No.94, 07.11.2022, DA Rs.2.69 per point per day above 161), Domestic Work (G.O.(2D) No.99, 08.11.2022, DA Rs.32.25 per point per month above 248, base year 2015), Hospitals (G.O.(2D) No.21, 26.05.2025, DA Rs.53.90 per point per month above 161), Security Guards (G.O.(2D) No.81, 19.09.2024, DA Rs.56.00 per point per month above 161). Wage questions about those employments still refuse honestly until their schedules are verified the same way.
notes.scope: Tamil Nadu STATE minimum wages for three scheduled employments (Shops and Commercial Establishments; Tailoring Industry; Agriculture and works ancillary to Agriculture), read from the official G.O. PDFs on labour.tn.gov.in. Shops and tailoring give BASIC wages only: the G.O.s print no totals. The dearness allowance (DA) is a formula in each G.O. (a fixed rupee amount per month for every point the average Chennai City Consumer Price Index, base 2001=100, rises above a base figure), calculated every 1 April by the Commissioner of Labour on the preceding January-December average. The Commissioner's annual DA statement for the current year (cited by third parties as Order No. Z3/3459/2026, dated 18.02.2026, effective 01.04.2026) could not be located on any official site on 22 Nov 2026 (TN Labour Department site, TN Government Gazette weekly Part II Section 2 issues 7-18 of 2026, and the 2026 Extraordinary Gazette list were all searched), so NO current DA amount and NO total is stated for shops or tailoring anywhere in this file — the chunk text says so explicitly. Agriculture rates are all-inclusive (basic + cost of living allowance + cash value of concessions), so the printed daily rate IS the total. Third-party aggregator figures were never used, however plausible they look: one aggregator's hospitals DA figure (Rs.44 per point) contradicts the hospitals G.O. itself (Rs.53.90 per point, G.O.(2D) No.21, 26.05.2025).
notes.verification: Each G.O. is a scanned PDF with no text layer. Numbers were read by OCR (RapidOCR/onnxruntime, 150 DPI, 22 Nov 2026) and every schedule page was then read visually at 300 DPI to confirm the category-to-figure grouping: the OCR flattens merged table cells, and the visual read corrected the grouping in two places (shops general categories (1)-(5) share one rate, not (1)-(2); (6)-(13) share one rate, not (3)-(10)). The two DA per-point amounts the OCR garbled (shops Rs.40.18, tailoring Rs.33.94) were read visually from the page images, words and figures agreeing. No arithmetic sums exist to re-add: the G.O.s print basic rates only, so the validator checks structure (positive rates, consistent zone sets, DA block present exactly where the G.O. has a DA clause) instead of sums.
